title: Auranofin sensitizes breast cancer cells to paclitaxel mediated cell death via regulating FOXO3/Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway.
authors: Deepika, N; Rajendra Prasad, N; Radhiga, T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金诺芬联合紫杉醇通过FOXO3/Nrf2/Keap1通路增敏乳腺癌细胞凋亡，虽含分子对接但核心是细胞信号通路与药物机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) is a transcriptional factor which acts as a regulator for cellular oxidative stress, and tightly regulated by Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1). In this study, we found that auranofin and paclitaxel combination treatment increased TUNEL positive apoptotic cells and enhanced the DNA damage marker gamma-H2AX in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells. The immunoblotting analysis revealed the combination of auranofin and paclitaxel significantly increased the FOXO3 expression in a concentration dependent manner. Further we observed that auranofin and paclitaxel treatment prevents the translocation of Nrf2 in a concentration dependent manner. The increased FOXO3 expression might be involved in the cytoplasmic degradation of Nrf1-Keap1 complex. Further, the molecular docking results confirm auranofin act as the agonist for Foxo3. Therefore, the present results suggest that auranofin sensitize the breast cancer cells to paclitaxel via regulating FOXO3/Nrf2/Keap1signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）是一种转录因子，作为细胞氧化应激的调节因子，并受到Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的严格调控。在本研究中，我们发现金诺芬和紫杉醇联合处理增加了MCF-7和MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞中TUNEL阳性凋亡细胞的数量，并增强了DNA损伤标志物gamma-H2AX的表达。免疫印迹分析显示，金诺芬和紫杉醇联合处理以浓度依赖性方式显著增加了FOXO3的表达。进一步观察发现，金诺芬和紫杉醇处理以浓度依赖性方式阻止了Nrf2的转位。FOXO3表达的增加可能参与Nrf1-Keap1复合物的细胞质降解。此外，分子对接结果证实金诺芬作为Foxo3的激动剂。因此，本研究结果表明，金诺芬通过调节FOXO3/Nrf2/Keap1信号通路使乳腺癌细胞对紫杉醇敏感。
